notes.headline: LeBrown James runs the table
notes.dek: LeBrown James had the league's best week and moved to 3–0, Wembanyama dominated again in a loss, and the In-Season Tournament opened with four close calls and a few surprises.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax league data for Week 3 (Nov 2–8).

storylines.title: A perfect all-play week
storylines.body: LeBrown James would have beaten all 11 teams, with the league's best FG% (.492) and 763 points, and beat K-Ville 6–2–1. Donovan Mitchell scored 104 and Miles Bridges added 36 rebounds. They and Shanghai are unbeaten in the Rec division; Guangdong (3–0) and Bankruptcy (2–0–1) lead Pro-Am.

storylines.title: IST opening night
storylines.body: Tom (Bankruptcy) beat Pat 6–3, Zhang (Shanghai) beat Kevin 6–3, and Yash (LeBrown James) beat Cade. In Group B, Jakobi (Competing God) edged Bumpskiii 5–4, winning FT% by two thousandths (.765 to .763).

storylines.title: Wemby, again
storylines.body: Victor Wembanyama led the league for the second straight week: 123 points, 56 rebounds and 54% shooting. Blocktopus led the league in blocks (40) and won FG%, assists and steals, but Competing God took threes, points, rebounds, FT% and turnovers.

storylines.title: Presti's busy week
storylines.body: Sam Presti led the league in points (844), assists (203) and steals (62) and would have beaten 8 teams, but lost 6–3 to Shanghai, who led in threes (96) and rebounds (310). Presti's 118 turnovers were again the most in the league.

storylines.title: Rookies and the Brown Shirt
storylines.body: Darius Acuff topped the rookies with 101 points, ahead of Darryn Peterson (6 steals, 6 blocks). AJ Dybantsa (West Palm Salon) takes the Brown Shirt: 21 of 57 from the field.

matchups.070oazg4mqqv88in_n3z2eshxmqqv88in: IST Group A. Projects 8–1 Guangdong; Zach Babies' only projected edge is turnovers.
matchups.auysoygrmqqv88in_b33iacngmqqv88in: Projects 7–2 Blocktopus. Bankruptcy's edges are FT% and turnovers.
matchups.saydaqzgmqqv88in_rufupenmmqqv88in: IST Group B. Projects 7–2 Competing God, and a Jakobi win clinches the group. West Palm Salon is favored in assists and turnovers.
matchups.cipchrpimqqv88in_mizl2op8mqqv88im: IST Group C. Projects 5–4 Shanghai: threes, points, rebounds, assists and steals against OD's FG%, FT%, blocks and turnovers.
matchups.ctvglb6gmqqv88in_ygisq4rlmqqv88in: IST Group D. Projects 8–1 LeBrown James; eweiss35's best shot is points.
matchups.xoe774vlmqqv88in_d91prsm4mqqv88in: Projects 5–4 K-Ville, with threes, FT%, points, assists and turnovers against Presti's FG%, rebounds, steals and blocks.

bruno.d91prsm4mqqv88in: New No. 1. Darius Acuff (23 in the title season) leads a young core with Jalen Johnson (28) and a healthy Tyrese Haliburton, and their projected strength climbs every season.
bruno.auysoygrmqqv88in: Third. Flagg, Peterson and Wagler all turn 23 in the title season, with four picks still to come. Eleventh today, so the payoff is still a few years out.
bruno.070oazg4mqqv88in: Back up to second, and second today too. Doncic is 31 in the title season, with Cade Cunningham (29) and Holmgren (28) still in their primes. No team is better on both lists.
bruno.b33iacngmqqv88in: Fourth on both lists. Wembanyama (26 in the title season) is the league's best long-term piece, with Rollins and Duren in their primes, but no picks remain to add depth.
bruno.saydaqzgmqqv88in: Fifth, with eight picks, the second-most in the league. AJ Dybantsa, VJ Edgecombe and LaMelo Ball are the core, and their strength rises every season.
bruno.ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Seventh. Maxey anchors it, but Tatum (32) and Donovan Mitchell (34) will be on the back nine by 2030–31, so the line stays flat.
bruno.mizl2op8mqqv88im: Up to sixth. Shai is 32 in the title season, with Kon Knueppel (25) as the young piece. Third today, so the window is now.
bruno.xoe774vlmqqv88in: Eighth. The best roster today, but Jokic is 35, Murray 33 and Bane 32 in the title season, and their strength falls every year.
bruno.rufupenmmqqv88in: Ninth. Cameron Boozer (23 in the title season) and Morez Johnson are a real young base, but their strength fades as the veterans age.
bruno.cipchrpimqqv88in: Tenth. Amen Thompson and Dyson Daniels (both 27 in 2030–31) are the base; the veterans around them age out, so the line drifts down.
bruno.ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Eleventh. Porter is 32 and Giannis 35 in the title season, and they hold no picks.
bruno.n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Twelfth, but ten picks are the most in the league. Nate Ament and Hannes Steinbach are the start; expect a big climb once those picks become players.
